mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", entity_id AS "entityId", attr_key AS "attrKey", base_value AS "baseValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.entity_attribute_values WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND entity_id = #{entityId} AND attr_key = #{attrKey}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.entity_attribute_values (game_id, entity_id, attr_key, base_value, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{entityId}, #{attrKey}, #{baseValue}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id, attr_key) DO UPDATE SET base_value = EXCLUDED.base_value, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", entity_id AS "entityId", attr_key AS "attrKey", base_value AS "baseValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.entity_attribute_values WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, entity_id, attr_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.entity_attribute_values_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, entity_id, attr_key, base_value ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, entity_id, attr_key, base_value FROM public.entity_attribute_values WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id, attr_key, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, base_value = EXCLUDED.base_value
